description.value: A fast-food location on Harvey Avenue, one of Kelowna's main commercial strips, positioned conveniently for cyclists passing through the city core. The OSM record identifies it as KFC, but the linked website is a Taco Bell location page with the same address and phone — it is likely a co-branded KFC/Taco Bell restaurant. Either brand offers quick, affordable hot food and takeout options well-suited to a mid-ride stop.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The OSM record names this location 'KFC' but the website URL embedded in OSM leads directly to a Taco Bell location page at the same address and phone number; the website content makes no mention of KFC and is entirely branded as Taco Bell, suggesting either a co-branded KFC/Taco Bell site or an OSM naming error. The phone (250-860-3338) and address (2271 Harvey Avenue, Kelowna, BC V1Y 6H2) are confirmed by the website. Takeout is supported by OSM tag takeaway=yes and website order options; vegetarian items are confirmed by the website's explicit Veggie Cravings Menu mention.
concerns: OSM name is 'KFC' but the website URL in OSM leads to a Taco Bell location page at the identical address and phone number — likely a co-branded KFC/Taco Bell site or an OSM tagging error; contact_confirmed.website set to false because the website does not confirm the KFC identity.
OSM tag drive_through=no but the Taco Bell website prominently lists 'drive-thru hours', indicating a drive-through is present — OSM tag appears incorrect.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, open fast-food location on a major Kelowna thoroughfare; brand name discrepancy in OSM does not affect its utility to touring cyclists.
